notes: Verified against the department Fall 2024 page and UCSD General Catalog. 18 courses total: 6 lower-division + 12 upper-division. All courses taken for a letter grade with C- or higher, EXCEPT USP 30 which is Pass/No Pass only. Upper-division work requires 2.0 major GPA. Optional Honors: USP 190. Note: catalog title for USP 30 is 'Planning Practicum'; department page labels it 'Urban Studies and Planning Colloquium' - same 2-unit course.

buckets.label: Introductory urban course (required)
buckets.note: History of U.S. Urban Communities. Letter grade, C- or higher.

buckets.label: Urban world / global architecture (choose 1)
buckets.note: USP 2 Urban World System OR USP 6 Introduction to Global Architecture.

buckets.label: Social theory / real estate intro (choose 1)
buckets.note: USP 3 The City and Social Theory OR USP 5 Introduction to the Real Estate and Development Process.

buckets.label: USP Colloquium / Planning Practicum (required)
buckets.note: 2 units; Pass/No Pass only (exception to the letter-grade rule).

buckets.label: Foundation - required core (both)
buckets.note: USP 124 Land Use Planning and USP 173 History of Urban Planning and Design, both required.

buckets.label: Foundation elective (choose 1)
buckets.note: Confirmed on Fall 2024 page. USP 171/USP 100 removed from harvested extras? No - all present on page. Several cross-listed.

buckets.label: Technical elective (choose 1)
buckets.note: Recommended junior year. Matches page exactly.

buckets.label: Research methods (choose 1)
buckets.note: Recommended junior year. USP 188 cross-listed as SOCI 188. Matches page exactly. (USP 141A appears in catalog but is NOT on the Fall 2024 research-methods list, so excluded.)

buckets.label: Senior Sequence (both)
buckets.note: USP 186 Senior Sequence Research Proposal (6 units, Fall only) then USP 187 Senior Sequence Research Project (6 units, Winter only). USP 187 requires USP 186.

buckets.label: Upper-division electives
buckets.note: Choose 5. At least 3 must be USP courses. At most 1 special-studies course (USP 198 or USP 199) may count.
